description: This file contains classes and functions for tracking and managing JSON schema objects and enums, including dependency sorting, duplicate detection, and reference checks.

classes.name: ObjectTracker
classes.description: Tracks JSON schema objects, detects duplicates, and manages object dependencies.

classes.name: EnumTracker
classes.description: Specialized tracker for enum objects, detects duplicates, and manages enum dependencies.

methods.name: SortByDependency
methods.description: Sorts objects based on their dependency relations.

methods.name: IsInRef
methods.description: Checks if an object is within a reference schema.

methods.name: IsInCustomRef
methods.description: Checks if an object is within a specific custom reference schema.
